patch.value: Eliminate the last source any with real SDK handler context types

Replace the loose ctx: any parameter on runStandupCommand with the SDK's real CommandHandlerContext, imported type-only from @unbrained/pm-cli/sdk/authoring, so the shared command handler is contract-checked against the same shape registerCommand's run field expects. Behaviour must not change.

Zero any in index.ts; npx tsc --noEmit clean; npm test green (94 pass); npm run build clean; npm run changelog:check prints 'Changelog is up to date'; activation proof under pm-cli 2026.7.27 lists the standup subcommands and leaves host commands intact; output_format decline path returns { handled: false } unchanged.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: SDK type found in node_modules/@unbrained/pm-cli/dist/core/extensions/extension-types.d.ts: CommandHandlerContext (interface, extends PortableWorkspaceContext). Exported type-only via the package subpath @unbrained/pm-cli/sdk/authoring (re-exported from dist/core/extensions/loader.js). CommandHandler = (context: CommandHandlerContext) => unknown, matching registerCommand's run field. Replaced ctx: any with ctx: CommandHandlerContext. ctx.options is Record<string, unknown> (matches readStrOption/readBoolOption helpers), ctx.pm_root is string (matches fetchAllItems), ctx.global is GlobalOptions. No runtime guards needed to be preserved or added. Import is type-only from the same subpath ExtensionModule already uses, so no new runtime module edge.
